title: F.linear with bias corrupted rows once a batch dim exceeded 2^16
notes: Correctness, not performance -- included because the fix sits on the same dispatch threshold as the seq=1 decode cliff and any change to that heuristic must be measured on both sides of 2^16. Sibling of #195147 (pad corrupting rank>4 with >=2^16 inner elements, trunk only as of 2026-09-18).
